theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Technology (+1.46%) and Consumer Discretionary (+0.71%) led the market today, while Communication Svcs (-0.56%) and Industrials (-0.47%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.54%, defensives +0.45%, and value/cyclicals +0.13% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +1.69% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at +0.61%. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at +0.55%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 12.82% to 15.44, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 1.09% to $4,382.60, crude oil was little changed at $101.19, and bitcoin gained 0.36% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
